# Reeve

Reeve is a property marketplace and property-services business in India,
operated by Serial Makers Private Limited, HSR Layout, Bengaluru. Reeve
connects sellers with buyers and owners with tenants, and offers a family
of property services in Bangalore and NRI-focused services across India.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.reeve.in/): What Reeve is
- [Search Properties](https://www.reeve.in/search): Browse properties for rent and sale
- [Contact](https://www.reeve.in/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email

## Property services in Bangalore

- [All Bangalore property services](https://www.reeve.in/property-services-bangalore): Hub
- [Reeve Managed](https://www.reeve.in/property-management-bangalore): Ongoing property management
- [Reeve Watch](https://www.reeve.in/vacant-property-care-bangalore): Care for vacant properties
- [Reeve Let](https://www.reeve.in/find-tenant-bangalore): One-time tenant placement
- [Khata & Mutation](https://www.reeve.in/khata-transfer-bangalore): Property record transfers

## NRI property services (anywhere in India)

- [All NRI property services](https://www.reeve.in/nri-property-services-india): Hub
- [NRI Property Sale](https://www.reeve.in/nri-property-sale-india): Documents, tax & sale coordination
- [NRI Rent & TDS](https://www.reeve.in/nri-rent-tds-india): Withholding on Indian rent
